results.statement: For every finite p>=1, R_p(A)=sum_i sigma_i(A)^p is nonnegative, left/right orthogonally invariant, direct-sum additive, tensor-product multiplicative, and has the rank-one power formula.
Direct-sum additivity + tensor-product multiplicativity + reversible invariance + rank-one calibration/formula uniquely select the quadratic p=2 resource.
Schatten p norms/power sums and singular-value direct-sum/tensor identities are established matrix-analysis results.
Seeded audit over n=1..12,16,24,32,48,64,96,128 and p=1,2,3,4 found zero failures in 664 p-cases.
PDT primitives independently imply a degree-two scaling or continuous-mixing/resolved-channel law strong enough to exclude p!=2.
